author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Emergent Communication - Learned Signaling and Interpretation (Nuanced - Fixed NameError)
abstract: This corrected submission fixes a NameError in the previous experiment on nuanced emergent communication. The variable name 'observed_bin' is corrected to 'observed_signal_bin' in the update_learning method. The multi-agent simulation continues to explore how agents learn both to send and interpret numerical signals (discretized into bins) in a resource-sharing game, aiming to uncover the emergence of more sophisticated communication protocols and their impact on collective cooperation.
